title: Head of Growth (Commercial Insurance)
jobDescription: HEAD OF GROWTH (COMMERCIAL INSURANCE) At Plum, we have fundamentally transformed how organizations look at employee healthcare. Key Responsibilities Drive Revenue & Market Share: Relentlessly pursue and secure high-value corporate accounts. You will personally lead high-stakes negotiations and foster relationships with C-suite executives, CFOs, and Risk Officers. Build a High-Octane Team: Mentor, and inspire a world-class team of sales professionals and account managers. Foster a culture of extreme ownership, psychological safety, and high performance. Cross-Functional Synergy: Partner closely with Plum’s core EB sales teams to seamlessly cross-sell Non-EB products into our massive, existing corporate client base. Product & Underwriting Collaboration: Work hand-in-hand with insurance underwriters and our internal product teams to co-create tech-driven, customized risk solutions that disrupt traditional, clunky corporate insurance buying. Why This Role is Inspiring Uncapped Autonomy: You are getting the keys to a startup within a scale-up. You define the processes, choose the target markets, and build the team in your vision. The "Plum" Advantage: You aren’t knocking on cold doors. You have the leverage of Plum’s stellar brand reputation, industry-leading CSAT (NPS > 75), and an existing roster of thousands of fast-growing corporate clients waiting to be cross-served. Linear Impact on the Company’s Valuation: Non-EB is the strategic rocket fuel for Plum’s next phase of valuation. Your success will directly dictate the company's trajectory and future.
